note: Explanatory prose written by C3 describing what each section controls. This is authored text, NOT data extracted from the game — it is here so the builder can tell a player what they are about to bind. Keys match the `group` field in data-layer/processed/keybinds_site.json exactly (35/35).

provenance.Vehicle - Mobiglas: written 2026-08-09 against the 28 ui_3d_display_* action names; this section was absent from the prototype because all 28 of its actions are unlabelled
provenance.dropped: the prototype had an 'Other' catch-all bucket; it was an artefact of the prototype's own bucketing and is not a section in the repo data

sections.Camera - Advanced Camera Controls: The free camera used for screenshots and video — position, focus, depth of field and saved camera points. Nothing here affects flying.
sections.E.V.A - All: Moving in zero-g: thrust in every direction, brake, boost and orienting yourself when there is no floor.
sections.E.V.A. - Zero-G Traversal: Grabbing, pushing off and pulling yourself along surfaces in zero-g.
sections.Electronic Access - Spectator: Spectator mode controls, used when watching rather than playing.
sections.Flight - Docking: Requesting and confirming a docking connection with a station or another ship.
sections.Flight - HUD: Switching what the heads-up display shows you while flying.
sections.Flight - Movement: Thrust, pitch, yaw, roll, strafe, boost and speed limiter. This is the core of how the ship actually moves — if you fly with a stick, most of your axes belong here.
sections.Flight - Power: Routing power between weapons, shields and engines, and the throttles that control it. Bind these and you can shift power mid-fight without opening a menu.
sections.Flight - Quantum Travel: Spooling and engaging the quantum drive for long-distance travel.
sections.Flight - Radar: Radar range and mode while in the pilot seat.
sections.Flight - Target Hailing: Opening comms with whatever you currently have targeted.
sections.Ground Vehicle - General: Everything on a ground vehicle that is not driving it: lights, seats, weapons and utilities.
sections.Ground Vehicle - Movement: Driving — throttle, brake, steering and handbrake.
sections.On Foot - All: Walking, sprinting, crouching, prone, weapons, melee, gear and inventory. Everything you do with boots on the ground.
sections.Quick Keys, Interactions, and Inner Thou: The interaction system — looking at something and choosing what to do with it, plus the quick-key shortcuts that skip the menu.
sections.Social - Emotes: Gestures and expressions. Star Citizen ships forty of these and binds only six by default, so almost everything in this list starts unbound.
sections.Social - General: Chat, the contacts list and the social panel.
sections.Social - Invites: Sending, accepting and declining party invites.
sections.Turret Advanced: Gyro stabilisation, ammo, ESP and the settings that make a turret usable rather than just pointable.
sections.Turret Movement: Aiming a turret — the axes and speed controls once you are in the seat.
sections.VOIP, FOIP and Head Tracking: Push-to-talk, voice channels, face tracking and head tracking — including recentring your view.
sections.Vehicle - Mobiglas: The 3D holographic display inside your mobiGlas — the star map and the holo panels you pan, rotate, zoom and pin. Every one of these 28 actions is unnamed in the game's own data, so they carry no label here and will not appear in the action list above; the controls exist, the names for them do not.
sections.Vehicles - Cockpit: Cockpit-level actions: flight ready, self destruct, lights, doors and the things that belong to the ship rather than to flying it.
sections.Vehicles - Mining: Mining laser control — throttle, module switching and firing the extraction beam.
sections.Vehicles - Missiles: Arming, cycling and launching missiles, and breaking a lock.
sections.Vehicles - Multi Function Displays (MFDs: The cockpit screens. Selecting a panel, paging through it and interacting without taking your hands off the stick.
sections.Vehicles - Scanning: Scan mode, ping strength and reading what came back.
sections.Vehicles - Seats and Operator Modes: Getting in and out, switching seats, taking over turrets and stations, ejecting.
sections.Vehicles - Shields and Countermeasures: Shield facing, raising and lowering, and deploying flares, chaff and noise.
sections.Vehicles - Target Cycling: Stepping through hostiles, friendlies, attackers and pins — the fast way to change who you are looking at.
sections.Vehicles - Targeting: Acquiring a target, locking, pinning and cycling sub-targets. What you press before you shoot.
sections.Vehicles - View: Camera and look controls from inside the ship — freelook, zoom, look-behind and view modes.
sections.Vehicles - Weapons: Firing groups, weapon selection, gimbal control and countermeasure launch. The trigger and anything that decides what it shoots.
